# Walks of Italy

> > Premium guided tours and experiences across Italy's most iconic destinations including Rome, Venice, Florence, Vatican City, Pompeii, Naples, and Tuscany.

Walks of Italy specializes in small-group and private tours featuring skip-the-line access, VIP experiences, and expert local guides. Tours range from cultural walking tours and museum visits to food experiences and day trips across Italian cities and regions.

## Key Topics

- Small-group tours
- Skip-the-line access
- Private tours
- VIP experiences
- St. Mark's Basilica
- Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
- Doge's Palace
- Michelangelo's David
- Colosseum
- St. Peter's Basilica
- Florence Duomo
- Pompeii archaeological site
- Food & wine tours
- Tuscany day trips
- Guided cultural experiences

## Rome & Vatican Tours

- [Rome Tours & Day Trips from Rome](https://www.walksofitaly.com/rome-tours): Main Rome tours hub featuring Colosseum, Vatican & day trips
- [Private Vatican Tour | Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter's](https://www.walksofitaly.com/vatican-tours/private-vatican-tour): Private Vatican tour covering Museums, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter's Basilica
- [Priority Entry St. Peter's Basilica Tour with Dome & Crypts](https://www.walksofitaly.com/vatican-tours/st-peters-basilica-tour-dome-crypts): St. Peter's Basilica tour including dome climb and papal crypts
- [Testaccio Food Tour & Market Visit in Rome](https://www.walksofitaly.com/rome-tours/testaccio-market-food-tour): Rome food tour exploring Testaccio neighborhood market and trattorias
- [Rome Cooking Class for Families: Make Pizza Together](https://www.walksofitaly.com/rome-tours/rome-cooking-class-for-families): Family pizza-making cooking class in Trastevere with expert chefs

## Venice Tours & Experiences

- [Legendary Venice: St. Mark's Basilica & Doge's Palace Tour](https://www.walksofitaly.com/venice-tours/legendary-venice-st-marks-basilica-tours): Combined St. Mark's Basilica & Doge's Palace tour with VIP terrace access
- [Private After-Hours St. Mark's Basilica Tour | VIP Access](https://www.walksofitaly.com/venice-tours/private-st-marks-basilica-tour): Private after-hours VIP tour of St. Mark's Basilica with exclusive access
- [Private Venice Walking Tour & Gondola Ride](https://www.walksofitaly.com/venice-tours/private-venice-walking-tour): Private Venice walking tour with gondola ride and major landmarks
- [Venice Secret Itineraries: Exclusive Doge's Palace Tour](https://www.walksofitaly.com/venice-tours/doges-palace-secret-passages-vip-tour): Exclusive Doge's Palace tour featuring secret passages & Casanova's cell
- [Venice Express Tour: St. Mark's & Doge's Palace](https://www.walksofitaly.com/venice-tours/venice-express-day-tour): Express Venice tour covering St. Mark's Basilica & Doge's Palace quickly
- [Murano & Burano Tour with Glassmaking & Lagoon Winery](https://www.walksofitaly.com/venice-tours/murano-burano-tour): Murano & Burano islands tour with glassmaking demo and Sant'Erasmo winery
